A hybrid avian-mammalian species with a creamy white body, a bright yellow chest, and a vivid orange crest of feathers on the head. It has small, dark brown eyes and a sharp, yellow beak, with a single white wing attached to its left shoulder and a thick, pale yellow tail. Three clawed toes on each foot, with the right leg being a distinct, pale orange color.
BODY COLOR: creamy white
